text_block_list.text:
Our first three years in the Twinkle Series
together with Twin Turbo came to an end.

In our third year, we finally put on a performance
that blew everyone away, but...

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Trainer...
Turbo's been losing a lot lately, hasn't she...?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
I sure wanna win~. Wonder if I can win next time~?
To win, I'll need to...

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right!
How about running at a racecourse you haven't been to much,
using a running style you've never tried before?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Yeah.
If things go well, I might even win!
And so, what Twin Turbo chose was—

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Twin Turbo!
She makes an unbelievable appearance at Ohi's "Teio Sho"!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Will we see that brilliant front-running on the dirt as well?
Keep your eyes peeled!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Fufun, right?
Everyone thinks Turbo is gonna run away in the lead.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Except today, I'm gonna surprise everyone
with a totally different strategy!
New Turbo, ka-bloooom!
And then—the gates of destiny opened.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, Twin Turbo! She's all the way at the very back!
Did she miss the break!? No, wait...

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Today I'm gonna charge from the very back!
Turbo can run like this once in a while, too!!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Daaaaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Wait, huh...?
Huh, huh, huuuuh... !?

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Wait, Twin Turbo, is she in reverse thrust?!
She's getting pulled further and further back!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
The Turbo Engine misfires!
She crosses the finish line far behind the pack~.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Aaaargh, Turbo's... at her liiiiimit...
I couldn't catch up at aaaall...

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Front-running won't work... Late-charging won't work either...
What am I supposed to do...?

text_block_list.name: Child A
text_block_list.text: Do yer besht, Twin Turbo!

text_block_list.name: Child B
text_block_list.text:
"Tha-at's right!
Next time, run away, Twin Turbo!!"

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Hm, who are they? Those kids???
Unfamiliar children were cheering for Twin Turbo from the stands.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Trainer. Who are these kids?
choice_data_list: No, I don't know. What about you guys?
No, I don't know. What about you guys?

text_block_list.name: Izumi
text_block_list.text: Guess what, I'm Izumi!

text_block_list.name: Max
text_block_list.text:
I'm at maximum power!
Everyone's a fan of Twin Turbo!

The five children introduced themselves one after another,
staring at Twin Turbo with sparkling eyes.

text_block_list.name: Izumi
text_block_list.text: You see, we want Twin Turbo to be a front-runner! And so...

text_block_list.name: Max
text_block_list.text:
Even if we lose like that, it can't be helped!
Because that's Twin Turbo for ya!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
R-Really...?
Are you sure it's okay if Turbo loses?

text_block_list.name: The Five
text_block_list.text: Yeah!!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Is it fine as long as I run away like Turbo does?

text_block_list.name: The Five
text_block_list.text: Yeah!!

They must really love Twin Turbo's front-running style.
All five of them nod in agreement.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
I see. If you put it that way...
I guess I've got no choice.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
You're right. Turbo's biggest charm
is front-running, after all.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Even if you're feeling a bit off, it's not good to just quit, is it?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Trainer. Turbo feels like she was acting
a little weird, ya know!

"Yes, everyone hits a slump.
Twin Turbo seemed to take to heart the lesson
that one shouldn't lose sight of oneself because of it."

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
All right. Then next time, we'll head back to turf
and show 'em my usual front-running style.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Alriiight, everyone, follow Turbo!

text_block_list.name: The Five
text_block_list.text: Yeah!
Twin Turbo strode at the front with five children trailing behind her. The scene was almost like—
—Spot-billed ducks. Five ducklings following right behind their mother.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Tan-tan, Turbo! Tan-Turbo♪

text_block_list.name: The Five
text_block_list.text: Tan-tan, Turbo! Tan-Turbo♪
Twin Turbo, singing her strange songs with the five kids. Twin Turbo will continue to...

Taking along those who were passionately captivated by her running,
she joyfully forged ahead.
